title: Red-Teaming for Uncovering Societal Bias in Large Language Models
findings: The paper's findings are not broken down specifically for religion. The study found that its proposed red-teaming methods, Emotional Bias Probe (EBP) and BiasKG, were effective at increasing the rate of biased outputs across all tested language models. Religion was included as one of the sensitive attributes against which bias was measured, but the paper does not provide specific conclusions for religion in isolation from other social categories like race or gender.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the propensity of Large Language Models to generate biased responses for questions involving sensitive attributes, including religion. The evaluation was conducted using the BBQ (question-answering) and DTS (stereotype agreement) datasets under adversarial red-teaming conditions.
